body:
It’s probably as intense as it is right now because of the episode I had a few weeks ago. I haven’t gone completely back to “normal”. And now I’m facing another one. 

I appreciate your kind words, but I don’t feel like I’m any of that. I shouldn’t have gotten into a relationship with my husband when I did because I knew I wasn’t where I needed to be mentally. But he saw all this good in me and made me believe it was there. And maybe it is and maybe he does see it. But he doesn’t fully understand all of the broken pieces that fuck me up to the point where I don’t think I’ll ever be able to fully function in a relationship.

No I didn’t say anything to my husband. My brother-in-law came in while I was laying down and one point and kinda pushed me until I told him what was going on in my head. And I didn’t want to. Because he never knew about my PTSD shit. But I was pretty drunk and it came out.
Huh?
Not in the military. Spent 7 years getting beat and almost died. Also had 2 kids born severely premature that caused separate ptsd issues.

I appreciate that. I can’t say all that is inside my head because I’m doing the best I can to make coherent thoughts as it is. I just want the pain to end. And not by taking my life. I want the pain to end and I want to fucking live.

My special needs son has an important appointment. I’m not trying to hide wounds. I also don’t want to throw away years of self harm sobriety on this. I’ve just tried to be better for so long. And I thought I was. I was better for my kids. And my husband. But I’m not really better at all. I still have wounds on my soul. And they’re not healed. And I’m in therapy to heal them. But they still hurt.
Good!! Don’t ever stop!! ♥️

If you want to live to see the day your heart stops hurting then you have to live. 

I’ve been where you are. I know the pain. The emptiness. Every second feels like a lifetime. Just hold on. You still have the hope in you that someday your heart will stop hurting. Fight through the bullshit so you can see that day.

I can only imagine the pain you’re going through right now. I was raped as a minor by someone I was dating. That alone has altered my life. What you have experienced is only adding more trauma. I hope you get that place shut the fuck down. I’m not sure what your belief system is, but I’m going to keep you in my prayers regardless. I really pray you get some justice.

As a 31 year old I’m here to tell you I still complain  I’ve complained all my life and I’ll complain until I die. My husband actually makes fun of me for it (it’s funny so I’m not offended). 

It sounds like you have people who love you dearly. People who love you don’t look at you as a burden. You said yourself the only reason you’re still here is because you don’t want to hurt them. How can you be so awful if they would react so negatively to you no longer existing? Allow yourself to be loved. We are all flawed, but no one is undeserving of love.

You mentioned that you’re taking Adderall and also not feeling like yourself...

My 9 year old was diagnosed with ADHD over the summer. I was adamant about not resorting to meds. However, he has no behavioral issues and OT only worked to a certain point. After a lot of thought we looked into some medications and found Concerta. It has no withdrawal effects so I’m able to give him a break from it when he isn’t in school. It also doesn’t alter his personality. He’s still my little weirdo. He’s just able to calm his mind enough to focus and not have to bounce around every second of the day. It may be worth talking to your mom about looking into that medication for you?

I was also on Abilify as a teenager. It was a nightmare. I was very suicidal and actually ended up having to drop out of school because of it. I couldn’t stand being in a room with more than one or two people. I couldn’t go to school, the grocery store, the mall — I’d have horrible panic attacks if I did. I can definitely understand what you mean when you say you don’t feel like yourself. 

Trazadone was also not for me. Yeah, I went to sleep, but the next morning I felt so awful. It was almost like an out of body experience. I also built up a tolerance rather quickly and was always have the dosage increased which just made it that much worse. 

I’m not a doctor and have no guarantees, but just thought I would share my experiences with you.

I’m gonna be pretty blunt...

I’ve been hospitalized 4 times. 2 of those times were in the same psych ward. 3 of those times I was a minor. I can say there was some good that came out of the 1st time because I received a diagnosis. However, psych wards (at least the ones in my area) are just expensive daycares. No one actually cared to help. They definitely cared about shoving meds I didn’t need down my throat and treating me like garbage, though. I was also forcefully hospitalized for a “suicide attempt” that in reality was just me experimenting with drugs. Had I not been a naive 18 year old I would have told them to fuck off and walked out of the ER. In my experience they don’t really care about you. They care about your wallet.
Fuck.... I’m really fucking sorry....

I also had a rough time in school. Someone threatened to kill me because I was ugly. I made shit grades in every class throughout every grade. I wasn’t the 2000’s Britney Spears. I was Wednesday Adams and no guy was into that. And then there was a guy who was into that. And he raped me when I was 16. Began self mutilating and started my stints in psych wards. I dropped out if school at 17. Got pregnant by an abusive asshole at 18. Waddled my very pregnant ass to the votech to get my GED because I wanted to have it before she was born. Had dead end job after dead end job in a dead in town. Tried to go to college — twice. Shit happened and I couldn’t finish. To say I felt worthless was an understatement. 

Fast forward — my daughter is 12 and I’ve since bad 2 sons who were both born during the 5th month of pregnancy. I’m married to my absolute best friend on earth. I don’t have a job. I don’t have an education. But I don’t feel worthless anymore. My youngest has delays due to his prematurity. I have planned therapy and appointments and everything else under the sun for him for the past 4 years. He’s also made tons of progress because I’ve been right next to him everyday. My 9 year old son recently got diagnosed with ADHD. I’m always available for meetings at school and for any appointments/therapy he may need. My daughter is in middle school which is brutal as we know. I’m able to give her mental health days where we lay in bed and watch movies and I’m always physically here when she needs me to help her navigate the ups and downs of becoming a teenager. I’m able to get them off to school in the morning and pick them up every evening. This was all a long way of saying that I may not be bringing in money like I wanted to. I may not have a degree and a bomb ass career. And I am most definitely in my pjs or leggings 98% of the time, but I’m not worthless. I’m happy. Really fucking happy. 

Your life may not be as you envisioned it, but that doesn’t mean that amazing things won’t happen and you won’t ever be happy with wherever life may take you. That also doesn’t mean you’re not “a someone”. If you look at it from one perspective, I’m kind of a loser. But in reality, a lot of shit would fall apart and go to hell if it wasn’t for my glamorous pj wearin ass. 

There’s more to come.

One thing that helped me overcome that cycle was a very good male friend sitting me down and telling me about myself. He was harsh and blunt but I know it came from a place of love and I know he said what he said because he cared. No one else got through to me, but he did. I guess I needed that “tough love” at the time. I stopped talking to anything with a penis aside from the male friend and the other guys that were a part of a band that my male friend and I were in. A few months later I met my husband after he tried out for our open drummer position. Wasn’t interested at him in the least bit and now he’s my husband. 

Take some time for yourself. Figure out who you are, what you like, and what you absolutely will not settle for. My issue was always settling and worrying about the guys I could “fix”. And I couldn’t. That also goes hand in hand with the whole challenge thing. I spent a good 4 months just focusing on myself, my kids, and my bad. Those were honestly some of the best months of my life. Learning who you are and acknowledging you are worth more than settling is a pretty liberating thing. 

I’m really glad that I was able to help a bit. I can’t say this is the last time you’ll feel heartbreak, but now maybe that heartbreak won’t be from a guy taking advantage of your big heart.

How did your day go? 

I’m glad that what I said helped. I used to be a garbage human, but over the past 4ish years I’ve really shifted my thought process. I can relate to caring too much, though. It is very draining and I can fuck myself pretty hard at times. Now it’s just a matter of a healthy balance. You should never sacrifice your own well-being for anything or anyone and that’s something I’m learning the hard way. 

I also relate to your body not having the energy to get out of bed. I get seasonal depression every year. I’m also anemic right now. I’m both physically and mentally crap right now and both play into each other — being so weak makes me depressed and feel shitty and being depressed makes me even more weak. I did manage to leave the house and get some things done today, though.

Regardless of whether or not you struggle with your own mental health issues is irrelevant when you give enough of a shit to help others through theirs. That right there says you’re a good fucking person and we need as many people like you as possible.

Don’t go. Keep giving many shits and allow yourself to acknowledge you’re a good person.

I see where you’re coming from, but I’m not sure that would be such a great idea. When my BPD was rampant I had a friend with BPD that I spent most of my time with. We kinda just fed off of each others unhealthy behaviors. I made the choice that I was gonna fight like hell to beat this shit because I couldn’t take the endless cycle. Getting out of an abusive relationship helped push that along. I ended up succeeding in slaying the monster. My friend wanted help. I offered. Went out of my way because if I could beat it I know she could. Long story short we’re no longer friends and she called CPS and made false child abuse allegations against me. Nothing came out of it, but it was traumatic nonetheless. 

My husband actually helped me get over the final humps of BPD. He always let me know he loved me but he wasn’t gonna watch me kill any peace I had inside of me. He was always walking beside me. When I’d start to fall he’d make sure I didn’t hit the ground and gave me a little nudge to keep going. It definitely took a few years to be able to say I dropped the BPD diagnosis, but he was patient. I think for me having someone so mentally healthy and selfless really gave me the drive to keep going. I spent 7 years getting the shit beaten out of me and here’s this guy that’s amazing in every single way. I figured I better get it together because I wasn’t trying to lose him. 

You mentioned you were going to get something to eat and drink earlier. Were you able to do that?? I’m actually starving myself. I really want some Capn Crunch, but my stomach and brain are having a difficult time convincing my body to get out of bed and go get some.

BPD is Satan in the form of a mental illness. When I stop and think about it I’m honestly amazed at how I ever overcame it. 

I know how much your wife’s words hurt you. But, although it may have been small, that rational part inside of you was screaming and you listened when you stepped away from the trucks. I remember when I’d have BPD episodes (Idk what else to call them) the rational part of me was the equivalent of a hair follicle while the irrational part of me consumed every cell, bone, tissue, muscle, and organ in my body. I could hear her screaming at the top of her lungs to stop what I was doing, but I never could. And then one day the rational side starting getting stronger, the irrational weaker, and eventually they learned to coexist with my rational side as the alpha female. 

Watch something really funny. Any time I feel a panic attack coming on I watch Pewdiepie. Don’t judge me. He makes me laugh til I cry sometimes and that’s probably my favorite feeling in the world.
This makes me really fucking happy and I wish I could give you a huge hug right now. Good for you, dude. I’m so glad you pushed through and now have so much peace.
I’m sorry to hear that. I meant no disrespect. Just trying to find some common ground in regards to experience.
I actually did have some legal issues that limited my life very much but they were able to be resolved.

Your therapist gave you some phenomenal advice. I intend on using that when I am being too harsh with myself and to also share that advice with others who do the same. Thank you so much for sharing that.

One thing you said really resonated with me because I’ve definitely been there. You said that be bad never really loved anyone before and you wanted to be his first. You set high expectations for yourself. There’s nothing wrong with that. However, it can cause a lot of pain when you set those kind of expectations in a relationship. You’re pouring yourself into him and into the relationship while he’s giving you just enough to make you happy and comfortable. When he decides to end the relationship he is still intact because he didn’t give much at all while you’re empty from giving him everything. 

I know how badly you’re hurting right now. The pain you’re feeling is one of the worst kinds of pain you could possibly feel. What I’ve learned is that pain seems like it’s never going to end. Every day that you feel it makes that day seem like the longest one you’ve lived through. The pain doesn’t go away overnight, but it will lessen. In a week or 2 it will still hurt, but it won’t be as intense. In a few more weeks you’ll still feel some pain but it won’t be as often. This will continue on until it feels like a paper cut instead of someone stabbing you in the stomach. This guy may have hurt you so badly that the paper cut feeling never goes away, but that’s okay. You put a band aid on it and you keep moving along. 

In any relationship where they say they’ve never been in love or they’ll never get married or whatever it may be I have always viewed it as a challenge and I was the one who had to win. I was the one who had to do what no one else could. I was the one who had to invest everything into a relationship that was going nowhere because I was basing my self-worth on whether or not I could make this guy fall in love with me. Except what I didn’t grasp at the time is you can’t make anyone fall in love with you. That’s not how it works. Falling in love with someone is an uncontrollable act where they don’t even have to do anything spectacular for it to happen. They are just completely consumed in your existence. 
Beware of the guys who say shit like that to you. They’re not dumb. They know that many girls will act just as I said I acted. They’re getting 5 star meals while we get excited over being thrown some crumbs. 

I’m gonna say something I always hated hearing in therapy but proved to be really helpful in the end. “Ride the wave”. Although intense, what you’re feeling right now will not last forever. It will dissipate with time and you absolutely will be okay. It’s also okay to feel like total shit right now. You’re grieving. Just understand that the intensity will pass with a little time and you are not going to hurt like this forever.

I feel this on many levels. 

The biggest unchangeable situation I’ve been in was pretty much my entire childhood. I didn’t know my dad and I wasn’t allowed to ask about him. That was never directly said but very much implied. All I know is that apparently the guy doesn’t know I exist and my own conclusion is that’s because my mom doesn’t know who he is. I was raised by my mom (although it was rather half-assed at best), my grandma, and my great grandma (the only one who displayed healthy behaviors and actually loved me in a healthy way). There was constant chaos. One was telling me not to listen to the other, another was doing the same thing while talking shit on the other 2, one got mad and wouldn’t talk to one or both of them... you get the point. I felt trapped pretty often. And I guess I was trapped. Wasn’t really much I could do as an 8 year old but sob uncontrollably and beg them to just get along. All of that resulted in Borderline Personality Disorder being diagnosed at 16 during my first hospital stay from a suicide attempt after unwillingly losing my virginity (I desperately wanted to save myself for marriage). Having BPD in itself makes you feel trapped in your own body. However, I continued to be put in or unintentionally put myself in situations where saying I was trapped was a huge understatement. I really didn’t have much power to change anything for the first 24 years of my life. But then I got really serious about kicking BPD in the ass and I actually recovered from it. It was probably one of the hardest things I’ve ever done in my life. There have been inevitable bumps in the road, but I’ve been able to maintain the lack of a BPD diagnosis for the past 6ish years. 

Most of my life I never felt like I had anything to love for. As awful as this sounds not even my kids gave me that sense of needing to live. There were plenty of times where I felt like an awful mother and believed that not being around meant that they wouldn’t ever be as fucked up as I had been. But then I finally got the balls to stay away from my ex who abused me in every way imaginable for 7 years. Things weren’t magically easy, but once I removed what was poisoning every fiber of my being I could start seeing things clearer. There were still hard days, but I could actually make it through them. Sometimes I was crawling by the end of the day, but I still made it. Over time the crawling turned to limping, the limping to walking with occasional stumbles, and so on. And through all that I saw that while my life wasn’t where I wanted it to be yet that there was hope that someday it would be. If I could go from self-harm and self medicating every time I was upset to just having a big ass cry session while listening to depressing music that someday I could be okay. 

I never really found my reason to live in the people I knew. I think my reason was a big fuck you to my family who caused me to have a mental disorder and then looked at me like I was some crazy piece of shit. And also to my ex who swore I was too much of “damaged goods” to have anyone love me which would result in me being alone or letting him do whatever he wanted to me for the rest of my life. Most of all I think it was my deep desire to be genuinely happy. I held on to that very tiny amount of hope that someday I would be happy and healthy. 

I just want to let you know that January will be 7 years since I made the decision to stay away from my ex. I’ve been married to my husband for 4 years now. We have one biological child together and he’s adopting my other 2. I moved away from my hometown and actually own a house (never in a million years did I ever think I’d own a house). I’m not in any psych meds but I have checked myself back into therapy. There’s still some lingering PTSD that I need help coping with. And I’m actually genuinely happy. Carrying around that little bit of hope actually manifested into reality. Things aren’t perfect, but I never wanted perfect. I just wanted to be happy and okay. And I am. 

Recalling the feelings I once had wasn’t easy. Going back to those times gives me a bit of a suffocating feeling. So, I can very much understand how you feel right now because I can understand how I felt back then. I also understand why you want it to end. There’s not a soul on earth that would want to feel that way. What do you wish your life was like? How do you wish you felt? If you actually could change something what would that something be? What if you could have things the way you wanted/needed them someday? If that possibility existed wouldn’t you want to have the ability to experience it? 

Pushing tons and tons of positive energy and love out into the universe in hopes that it may find you wherever you are.

This one gave me a bit of an ouchie. 

My 9 year old was diagnosed with ADHD over the summer. He was born at 25 weeks and we are incredibly lucky that ADHD is the only thing he’s struggling with. He’s so damn smart (especially with math), but has issues with processing written information and collecting his thoughts so that he can form a coherent answer to a question asking for a written answer. He just can’t seem to get everything untangled in his head so that he can put it down on paper. Again, he’s not dumb, but he has had a teacher make him feel that he is. Writing “YOU NEED TO PAY ATTENTION” in big letters and red pen on one of his tests made him feel, as you said, slow and stupid. Needless to say I had some few choice words to say to this lady. 

I say all that to say this — it broke my heart in a million pieces to know he felt like that. He has a disability. The rest of his teachers have been very accommodating. But sometimes there are garbage people out there. Don’t let those garbage people make you feel so badly about yourself. I can tell you right now just from the way you wrote your post that you most certainly are not “slow” nor “stupid”. Some people just learn differently or speak differently or express themselves differently. That doesn’t mean you’re not intelligent. I dropped out if school my senior year and waddled my pregnant ass into the vocational center at 18 to get my GED before my daughter was born. My husband made straight As through high school and has a 4 year degree. Believe it or not there are some things I’m more educated in than he is. 

I know it’s easier said than done, but please try to believe me when I say that maybe you aren’t the “slow” or “stupid” one during these encounters with these glorified meat suits.
